## Highlights since 0.16.18

- **Drag project tabs.** Project tabs can be dragged to reorder them, torn off into a new window, or moved between windows. Thanks to @knightnemo for the first version (#1013).
- **Tell same-named tabs apart.** Two open files with the same name now show enough of their folder to tell them apart, hovering a tab shows its path, and the tab menu can copy it.
- **The Agent cites into the right bibliography.** The Agent now adds citations to the `.bib` file your document actually uses, cites a GitHub repository by its own citation, finds a reference written out with its authors and year, and finishes upgrading a long bibliography's preprints instead of timing out.
- **Cleaner Overleaf sync.** Package cache folders such as `_minted` and achemso's `acs-main.bib` stay out of the file tree and sync, your own PDF build is no longer kept as a conflict copy, and a held file move says which role is holding it back.
- **Faster saves in long documents.** Saving a long `.tex` file no longer rescans its labels from the start for every label, and the word count runs at most every 15 seconds while you keep saving. Thanks to @rawinan-soma for the report (#1025).

## Notable fixes

- In Vim mode, `$` moves to the end of the line in normal mode again instead of typing `$$`. Thanks to @Thomasbush9 for the report (#1020).
- The window follows the cursor as soon as you drag its title bar, without a short delay. Thanks to @peterwjacko for the report (#1063).
- Clean rebuild cleans the document it is about to build, so a paper and its supplement in one folder no longer lose each other's labels.
- Windows: a project window saved on a screen that is no longer attached opens on the main screen. Thanks to @ivanvykopal for the fix (#1024).
